pairs: obey your parents in the Lord,
quod est mandatum primum in promissione:
This is the first commandment with a promise:
so that it may be well with you,
and so that you may have a long life upon the earth.
nolite ad iracundiam provocare filios vestros:
do not provoke your children to anger,
but educate them with the discipline and correction of the Lord.
be obedient to your lords according to the flesh,
in the simplicity of your heart,
Do not serve only when seen,
but act as servants of Christ,
doing the will of God from the heart.
scientes quoniam unusquisque quodcumque fecerit bonum,
For you know that whatever good each one will do,
the same will he receive from the Lord,
scientes quia et illorum et vester Dominus est in cælis:
knowing that the Lord of both you and them is in heaven.
et personarum acceptio non est apud eum.
For with him there is no favoritism toward anyone.
by the power of his virtue.
Be clothed in the armor of God,
ut possitis stare adversus insidias diaboli:
so that you may be able to stand against the treachery of the devil.
quoniam non est nobis colluctatio adversus carnem et sanguinem,
For our struggle is not against flesh
against the directors of this world of darkness,
against the spirits of wickedness in high places.
ut possitis resistere in die malo,
take up the armor of God,
so that you may be able to withstand the evil day and remain perfect in all things.
State ergo succincti lumbos vestros in veritate,
Therefore, stand firm, having been girded about your waist with truth,
and having been clothed with the breastplate of justice,
et calceati pedes in præparatione Evangelii pacis,
and having feet which have been shod by the preparation of the Gospel of peace.
In all things, take up the shield of faith,
in quo possitis omnia tela nequissimi ignea extinguere:
with which you may be able to extinguish all the fiery darts of the most wicked one.
And take up the helmet of salvation
et gladium spiritus (quod est verbum Dei),
and the sword of the Spirit (which is the Word of God).
Through every kind of prayer and supplication,
et obsecrationem orantes omni tempore in spiritu:
pray at all times in spirit,
et in ipso vigilantes in omni instantia
and so be vigilant with every kind of earnest supplication,
ut detur mihi sermo in apertione oris mei cum fiducia,
so that words may be given to me,
as I open my mouth with faith to make known the mystery of the Gospel,
pro quo legatione fungor in catena,
in such a manner that I may dare to speak exactly as I ought to speak.
ita ut in ipso audeam, prout oportet me loqui.
For I act as an ambassador in chains for the Gospel.
Ut autem et vos sciatis quæ circa me sunt,
so that you also may know the things that concern me and what I am doing,
a most beloved brother and a faithful minister in the Lord,
will make known everything to you.
quem misi ad vos in hoc ipsum,
I have sent him to you for this very reason,
ut cognoscatis quæ circa nos sunt,
so that you may know the things that concern us,
and so that he may console your hearts.
et caritas cum fide a Deo Patre
from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Gratia cum omnibus qui diligunt Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum in incorruptione.
May grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ, unto incorruption.
